summary: Backend-only regression run for ABPT meal-prep Stripe fix. 31/31 pytest passed (100%). Critical /api/payments/checkout/status 500 regression is FIXED — endpoint now returns HTTP 200 + payment_status='pending' even when emergentintegrations Stripe sandbox raises 'No such checkout.session'. Idempotency, 404 for unknown sessions, webhook_url persistence on payment_transactions, and webhook short-circuit (granted=True ⇒ paid+client+token without Stripe call) all verified. New POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint exists and returns HTTP 400 for empty/invalid signatures (not 404). All previously-passing endpoints (pricing, admin auth, admin clients CRUD, rotate-codes, code login, recipes, menu, shopping-list, checkout creation) still pass.

minor.issue: When tx.granted=True short-circuit branch fires, the response includes client and token keys, but token is the just-generated client subscription_token only if _grant_subscription has been called. The current short-circuit returns token=`<client_id>:<subscription_token>` BUT subscription_token may be empty string if granted was flipped manually without calling _grant_subscription (i.e. via the webhook path the token IS populated; via direct DB flip in tests it is empty). Not a bug in the fix — actual webhook delivery sets granted via _grant_subscription so token is populated correctly. Documenting for completeness.
Endpoint logs warning and returns 400 on invalid signature — good. Suggest also logging the event-id on success path for traceability.

critical_code_review_comments: checkout_status try/except correctly swallows emergentintegrations CheckoutError and returns cached tx state — regression resolved.
_grant_subscription uses single-writer mongo update {granted:{$ne:true}} + modified_count check → idempotent webhook delivery is safe.

POST /api/webhook/stripe always uses StripeCheckout(webhook_url='') — that's OK because handle_webhook only needs api_key + signature; just confirm emergentintegrations doesn't require webhook_url for sig verification.

Short-circuit branch returns token=`{id}:{subscription_token}` — if granted was set via webhook through _grant_subscription, this is correct. If granted is ever set externally without _grant_subscription, token will be `{id}:` (empty). Consider asserting subscription_token is set inside the short-circuit, or call _grant_subscription unconditionally when granted=True but subscription_token missing.
weekly_rotation_loop spawned via @app.on_event('startup') — prefer FastAPI lifespan handler (cosmetic).
STRIPE_API_KEY default 'sk_test_emergent' hardcoded as fallback — fine for sandbox but consider failing fast in production if missing.

rca of the issue: Previous 500 root cause: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status raised CheckoutError ('No such checkout.session') in sandbox immediately after session creation. Fix applied in /app/backend/server.py: (1) checkout_status() now wraps the SDK call in try/except and falls back to cached tx status from MongoDB (returns HTTP 200 + pending). (2) Added DB short-circuit: if tx.granted==True, return cached paid+client+token without calling Stripe. (3) Added POST /api/webhook/stripe to receive paid events in production. Verified by 7 new tests, all passing.
